name: hoppy
description: Hoppy, a tiny pixel pet, hops across your screen when Claude left you a question you haven't answered: it shows the chat's title and one click takes you straight to it (Windows + Claude desktop app)

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of Hoppy's speech bubble and messages: en (English) or es (Español).

discordWebhook.title: Discord webhook (optional)
discordWebhook.description: If set, after 10 minutes without an answer Hoppy also pings you on Discord. Leave it empty to skip Discord.
